_comment: Copy this to .claude/settings.json in the repo root before running Phase 2.
Defence in depth, §6.1 layer 3. The SDK does NOT load this file unless the
Layer 1 (disallowed_tools) and layer 2 (the PreToolUse hook) are the real
enforcement; these deny rules exist so a misconfigured SDK call fails safe.
Note: allowed_tools does not restrict anything under permission_mode
bypassPermissions - only disallowed_tools and hook denials do (§10).
